test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

Emily has just __come homes__ from school.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form** "homes".** The correct form should be **"home".**
 
• **"Home" **is the proper noun to indicate one's place of residence.
 
• The correct sentence should read **"Emily has just come home from school,"** ensuring **grammatical correctness and clarity.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Emily has just** come home** from school."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Come home:** This is the correct and standard phrase to indicate someone has returned to their place of residence.
 
• **Come homes, came homely, came homes:** These are incorrect forms and do not fit grammatically in the sentence.
 
• **No improvement:** This would be the correct option if the sentence were already correct, but it is not.
